steps.title: Why this matters
cards: A user says "I want to change my flight." The system has to figure out what they want, what information is missing, how to get it, and how to complete the action. Then the user says "wait, what if I cancel instead?" and the system has to remember the context, switch tasks, and preserve state.

Conversation is hard for an ML system. The input is open-ended. The output has to be coherent over many turns. The system may need to act on the world (change a flight, charge a card). Every wrong step is visible to the user.
